title: Central and Sheung Wan at street level, Peak by tram
summary: Extra pool / short promenade, one Star Ferry to Central. Street-level afternoon: markets, Tai Kwun, PMQ, Sheung Wan, siu mai at One Dim Sum, pizza. Walked through the zoo area, then Peak Tram up for evening views. Peak is done; no need to repeat tomorrow.

rows.detail: The best block for sun. Read, tan, swim. Optional short walk along the promenade / Avenue of Stars on the way to the pier if you want the harbour view before crossing.
From the pier beside the Clock Tower. Ten minutes across the harbour, Octopus at the gate. One trip over; stay out for the evening.

rows.what: Graham Street Market, Tai Kwun, PMQ, Mid-Levels escalator
rows.detail: The old street market first, then design and architecture, all within a few blocks. Siu mai at One Dim Sum (Lyndhurst Terrace), pizza nearby. Walked through the zoo / Hong Kong Park area. Ride the Mid-Levels escalator up to Hollywood Road for Tai Kwun and PMQ.

rows.what: Sheung Wan: Hollywood Road, Cat Street, Man Mo Temple
rows.detail: West along Hollywood Road for antiques, vintage and resale. Cat Street is the lane just below. Man Mo Temple is on Hollywood Road: ten minutes inside.

Tai Cheong Bakery, 35 Lyndhurst Terrace, near the bottom of the escalator: the classic short crust, daily 09:30 to 19:30, takeaway. Or Bakehouse on Staunton Street for the sourdough version and a proper coffee, to 21:00.

rows.what: Peak Tram up from Garden Road
rows.detail: Walked from Central area to Garden Road terminus. Round-trip tram for night views. Sky Terrace 428 if open (closes 10 PM). Peak done this evening; skip on Thursday.

Bar Leone on Bridges Street: walk-in only, expect a queue. Coa on Shin Hing Street: leave your number for the waitlist. Argo at the Four Seasons: bookable, harbour view. Lan Kwai Fong if you want a party. Home at the end: taxi through the tunnel, or the MTR from Central to Tsim Sha Tsui, two stops, last trains about 00:30. Or Peak down then ferry/MTR.

notes: Check the Observatory 9-day forecast and warnings for Thursday and Friday. Peak already done this evening.

Central and Sheung Wan still work: Tai Kwun and PMQ are partly covered, and the Mid-Levels escalator is roofed. Swap the pool for a slow lounge breakfast. Check the Observatory: Red or Black Rainstorm means stay in until it lifts (How-to 35).
Wednesday is ladies' night at many Lan Kwai Fong bars. Busy from about 22:00.
One ferry over mid-afternoon, Central street level + Peak Tram this evening. No Peak tomorrow.
